# Apex Tech

> Apex Tech is a premier digital engineering and design studio specializing in modern React & Next.js web development, bespoke UI/UX design systems, technical SEO, Core Web Vitals 95+ speed optimization, and high-conversion landing pages.

Apex Tech operates with direct engineer communication, clean client-owned code repositories, guaranteed delivery milestones, and a complimentary 30-day post-launch warranty.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Modern Web Development](https://its-sartaj.github.io/Apex-Tech/#services): High-performance, pixel-perfect web applications built with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- [UI/UX & Brand Design](https://its-sartaj.github.io/Apex-Tech/#services): Digital design systems, interactive Figma prototypes, and conversion rate optimized user interfaces.
- [Technical SEO & Speed Optimization](https://its-sartaj.github.io/Apex-Tech/#services): On-page SEO, structured Schema.org JSON-LD data, and Core Web Vitals speed tuning.
- [Conversion Landing Pages](https://its-sartaj.github.io/Apex-Tech/#services): High-converting marketing landing pages engineered for lead generation.
